avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may decrease methocarbamol levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive drowsiness; educate on fall risk

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on additive sedation risk; adjust dosing if needed

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase methocarbamol levels
caution_supplements.action: Limit grapefruit intake; monitor for increased side effects

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression, increased sedation, impaired cognition, and fall risk
caution_foods.action: Strongly counsel avoidance; warn against driving or operating machinery

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay methocarbamol absorption and onset of action
caution_foods.action: Take with or without food; consistent dosing schedule recommended

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive CNS depression, dizziness, and drowsiness—particularly with concurrent alcohol or CNS depressants. Assess liver and kidney function periodically, especially in elderly patients or those with hepatic/renal impairment.
